Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), PDF page 36: the slip of [[Dead Ewok (V) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Cancel Ellorrs Madak. [Immune to Sense] OR Use 2 Force to cancel the game text of an opponent's alien for remainder of turn. OR Place an Ewok Catapult in opponent's Used Pile. OR Make an Ewok power and forfeit = 0 for remainder of turn.”), word for word the text of [[Dead Ewok (V)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Master List (Dark Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
